title: Console telemetry gated-rollout: minimal cards pruning & graceful-degrade acceptance
creator: Anika Rao
description: Objective: Reduce the Console telemetry surface area for initial GA by pruning lower-value cards and defining a gated rollout that preserves critical functionality while minimizing token/compute cost. Background: multiple telemetry features (per-route flamegraphs, continuous trace captures, detailed cost breakdowns) push infra and telemetry ingestion beyond MVP budget. This ticket describes explicit scope cuts, the gated rollout mechanism (fidelity tiers + sampling), acceptance criteria, and follow-up work for re-enabling deferred features.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dashboard card set is reduced to: (a) Route list with 7-day RPS and error rate, (b) Aggregate cost summary (24h/7d), (c) Latency P50/P95 for selected model routes. No per-request KV dump or flamegraph card in MVP.

2) Tracing surface: sampling enabled at 0.5% global; configurable per-customer opt-in to increase sampling on Dedicated plans. Full continuous traces and span-level flamegraphs are removed from MVP release.

3) Cost breakdown: per-route estimated token cost is approximated using model bucket heuristics; detailed per-token breakdowns are deferred. Cost tile must display confidence level (low/medium/high) and an explanatory tooltip.

4) Rollout gating: telemetry features default to 'lite' for all new customers; an admin toggle in Console enables 'enhanced' telemetry after verifying quota and cost guardrails. Toggle change must require two-step confirmation for enterprise orgs.

5) Performance SLO: enabling lite telemetry must not increase median API latency by more than 3% and must not exceed an additional 8% ingestion cost for heavy workloads under our internal benchmark dataset.

6) Docs + UX: a short migration doc and a single help panel in Console must explain what's trimmed, how to opt-in, and known limitations. UX must include a contextual nudge when the admin toggles enhanced telemetry.
7) Monitoring: a runtime metric should track 'telemetry_mode' per-org and emit burn-rate alerts when cost delta exceeds configured threshold for 3 consecutive days.
8) QA: end-to-end smoke tests that simulate a 1k RPS route with lite telemetry must pass within agreed latency and ingestion budgets prior to release.
9) Acceptance sign-off: PM, Eng lead (runtime), and Security must approve the gated rollout doc and runbook.
decisions: Trim feature: Remove per-route flamegraphs and full-span captures from MVP — rationale: high ingest and storage cost with low initial customer signal; deferring reduces infra and speeds release.
Sampling: Implement 0.5% default trace sampling with per-org override. Decision based on cost/benefit on observability value and expected trace volume.
Cost estimate approach: Use model buckets and average token-per-request heuristics instead of full token accounting. Enables reasonable estimates without high instrumentation cost.
Gated toggle: Admin-driven opt-in for enhanced telemetry reduces accidental cost spikes for orgs; two-step confirmation for enterprise orgs balances safety with usability.
Fallback strategy: If 'enhanced' telemetry causes ingestion overruns, automatic downgrade to 'lite' telemetry per-org will occur and notify admins.
Deferred work: Reintroduce flamegraphs and per-token billing in a follow-up after autoscaling + retention improvements (tracked separately).
